title: 第296章 先宣传一波第295章 准备当婚车
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
孟晚晴和徐云云相处的非常不错。
主要徐云云非常乖巧懂事，一副好妹妹的样子，长得又这么漂亮，孟晚晴要是再摆脸色，那就是她不识大体了。
“大炮，如果是老宅翻新的话，可以省很多钱，是规划一块土地进行审批，那就贵多了。”
孟晚晴说道，他已经去大黑驴镇了解过，批新的宅基地，要交一部分昂贵的土地占用费，每个地方根据情况收费不一样。
有些农村一个平方就要收1000多块钱，按照一套房子100平方来算，光宅基地就得准备10多万。
他们这边还算便宜，而且还有万书记开绿灯，不过也需要五六百一个平方。
“老宅翻新肯定是不行的，不然大家住哪里去，只能规划一块土地进行审批。”
李大炮说道，而且他要打造的是新农村，在老宅上翻新重建，肯定不好规划。
“那得多花两三百万。”孟晚晴说道。
“没事，这个项目总投资需要五六千万，这两三百万算不了什么。”
李大炮说道，虽然感觉压力有点大，不过他有能力去解决。
孟晚晴心中自然非常感激，她觉得李大炮这么做，还是为了她。
只要这个新农村打造出来，到时候家家户户有房有车，而且还有一份不错的工作，他们牛犊子村，肯定要成为全国的示范村。
至于她这个村支书，白捡这么一个巨大的功劳，指不定到时候得连升好几级。
“大炮，我已经规划好了一块土地，看看能不能通过审批，要是能通过，我们就立即把设计图先做出来。”徐云云说道。
“媳妇，这些事情就交给你去办了。”
李大炮说道，不是他想当个甩手掌柜，而是确实比较忙。
另外把这些事情交给孟晚晴，也能提高她这个村支书在村里的威望。
“没问题的，都交给我了。”
孟晚晴答应下来，平常都太闲了，难得有事情做，她非常乐意干活。

搞定这些事情，李大炮又把徐云云送了出去，然后他就留在大黑驴镇开直播。
“大炮，你买车啦？”周念瑶问道。
“对的，现在经常要跑长途，开三轮车不太方便。”李大炮回道。
“何止是不方便，接下来天寒地冻的，自然是开小汽车更方便。”
周念瑶说道，原本她都想着，要给李大炮买辆车。
“时间差不多了，我们先去开直播，等做完中午的公益，下午我就去开始打造冰雪小世界。”
李大炮说道，刚好也趁机先宣传一波，先给他们的冰雪小世界打一波热度。
“你昨天变出来的冰雕依然栩栩如生，中午太阳晒进来了，也没有一点融化的迹象。”
周念瑶说道，现在还没有到天寒地冻的时候，这冰雕实在有点不一样。
“正常的，这是我打造出来的冰雕，肯定与众不同，估计到了夏天才会融化。”
李大炮回道，等到冰雕里蕴含的天地之力消耗殆尽，差不多也就要融化了。
周念瑶不知道他是怎么做到的，不过想到他所做的一切，都是这么神奇。
“对了，大炮，之前在网上收购的那些材料，现在已经陆陆续续寄过来了。”
content_en:
Meng Wanqing and Xu Yunyun get along very well.
The main thing is that Xu Yunyun is very well-behaved and sensible, looks like a good sister, and is so beautiful. If Meng Wanqing keeps showing off, it means that she is ignorant.
"Cannon, if you renovate an old house, you can save a lot of money. If you plan a piece of land and go through approval, it will be much more expensive."
Meng Wanqing said that he had gone to Daheilu Town to learn that new homesteads require an expensive land occupation fee, and each place charges different fees depending on the situation.
In some rural areas, one square meter charges more than 1,000 yuan. If a house is 100 square meters, more than 100,000 yuan would be needed for the homestead alone.
It's quite cheap here, and Secretary Wan has given the green light, but it still requires five to six hundred square meters.
"It is definitely not possible to renovate old houses. Otherwise, where will everyone live, we can only plan a piece of land and go through approval."
Li Dapao said, and what he wants to build is a new countryside. Renovating and rebuilding old houses will definitely be difficult to plan.
"That would cost two to three million more." Meng Wanqing said.
"It's okay. The total investment for this project is fifty to sixty million. Two or three million is nothing."
Li Dapao said that although he felt a bit stressed, he was capable of solving it.
Meng Wanqing was naturally very grateful. She felt that Li Dapao did this for her.
As long as this new rural area is built, and every household will have a house, a car, and a good job, their Niudaozi Village will definitely become a model village across the country.
As for her, the village party secretary, she might have to be promoted several levels in a row for such a huge achievement.
"Cannon, I have planned a piece of land to see if it can pass the approval. If it can pass, we will make the design drawing immediately." Xu Yunyun said.
"Daughter-in-law, I'll leave these things to you."
Li Dapao said that it was not that he wanted to be a hands-off shopkeeper, but that he was really busy.
In addition, leaving these matters to Meng Wanqing can also improve her prestige as the village party secretary in the village.
"No problem, leave it all to me."
Meng Wanqing agreed. She was usually too busy and rarely had anything to do, so she was very happy to work.
After settling these matters, Li Dapao sent Xu Yunyun out again, and then he stayed in Dahei Donkey Town to broadcast live.
"Cannon, have you bought a car?" Zhou Nianyao asked.
"Yes, I often have to run long distances now, so it's not convenient to drive a tricycle." Li Dapao replied.
"Not only is it inconvenient, it's going to be freezing cold, so naturally it's more convenient to drive a car."
Zhou Nianyao said that she originally thought about buying a car for Li Dapao.
"It's almost time. Let's start the live broadcast first. After finishing the charity at noon, I will start building a small ice and snow world in the afternoon."
Li Dapao said, taking the opportunity to promote it first and give their little ice and snow world a wave of popularity.
"The ice sculpture you made yesterday is still lifelike. The sun shines in at noon, and there is no sign of melting."
Zhou Nianyao said, it's not yet the cold weather, this ice sculpture is really a little different.
"It's normal. This is an ice sculpture I made. It must be different. It will probably melt in the summer."
Li Dapao replied that when the power of heaven and earth contained in the ice sculpture is exhausted, it will almost melt.
Zhou Nianyao didn't know how he did it, but thinking about everything he did, it was so magical.
"By the way, Cannon, the materials I purchased online have now been sent over one after another."
